sections.title: Why Me
sections.text: Hello Maria. You may be receiving this message because you are due for cervical and colorectal cancer screening. A research study is looking at ways to make these screenings easier for people in rural communities.

sections.title: About the Study
sections.text: The study is called "Multilevel Intervention Based on Colorectal Cancer (CRC) and Cervical Cancer Self-screening in Rural, Segregated Areas." It is studying ways to help people complete cervical and colorectal cancer screening, including self-sampling and educational materials.

sections.title: What Participation Involves
sections.text: If you take part, you may receive information about cancer screening and mailed screening materials. The study includes cervical cancer screening using an HPV self-sampling approach and colorectal cancer screening using a FIT test.

sections.title: Why You Are A Match
sections.text: The available information lists your preliminary study match as "Perfect Match." Your information indicates that you live in a rural Pennsylvania community and are overdue for both cervical and colorectal cancer screening.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.text: If you are interested, a member of the study team can explain the study, answer your questions, and confirm any Important details. Receiving this message does not mean that you have cancer, and you do not have to participate.
